summary: Iteration 587 - Voice-to-Report, Watchdog Conflict Detection, and Async Job Polling Testing. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with Voice-to-Report card, photo status badges, and AI Summary section.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice-to-Report, Watchdog Conflict Detection, and Async Job Polling features are working correctly. Backend intermittently times out during startup (database initialization warnings) but recovers after ~30 seconds. All new endpoints verified: POST /api/transcribe (returns 422 for missing audio), POST /api/daily-reports (includes conflict_watchdog metadata), GET /api/daily-reports.csv (returns 202 with job_id), POST /api/daily-reports/photo-intelligence/draft (returns photo_statuses array), POST /api/daily-reports/summary/draft (returns job_id for async processing).

voice_to_report_card.details: VoiceToReportCard component found at /daily/submit with data-testid='dr-v3-voice-report-card'. Mode toggles (Work Performed/Activities) work correctly. Record button shows 'Hold to speak' text.

voice_transcribe_endpoint.details: POST /api/transcribe endpoint exists and returns 422 for missing audio file. Accepts multipart form data with audio, field_hint, language_hint, project_number fields.

watchdog_conflict_detection.details: POST /api/daily-reports returns conflict_watchdog metadata with has_conflicts, requires_pm_review, schedule_source, yesterday_report, conflicts, checked_at fields.

async_csv_export.details: GET /api/daily-reports.csv returns 202 with job_id, status=queued, status_url. Polling /api/jobs/{job_id}/status reaches completed state with download_url in result.

job_status_polling.details: GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/status returns queued/processing/completed states. Returns 404 for nonexistent jobs.

photo_intelligence_draft.details: POST /api/daily-reports/photo-intelligence/draft returns photo_statuses array with per-photo status (photo_id, status, source). Status is 'no_photos' when no photos attached.

summary_draft_async.details: POST /api/daily-reports/summary/draft returns job_id with status=queued for async processing.

photo_status_badges_ui.details: PhotoUpload.jsx renders per-photo status badges with statusLabel (Queued/Analyzing/Complete/Cited/Retry needed/Unavailable) and statusTone (color classes). SectionPhotos passes photoStatuses to PhotoUpload.

ai_summary_section.details: DailySummaryAssist component found with completeness state and photo status display. Shows 'No photos attached yet.' when no photos.
